caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sculpture of a standing human figure, shown in a profile view facing left. The figure appears to be male and is nude, with both arms missing from the shoulders. The wood has natural brown and tan tones, with visible grain, texture, and areas of wear, particularly on the upper back and shoulder. The facial features, hair, and musculature of the torso and legs are rendered with detail. To the bottom right of the sculpture, there is a small, fine-line architectural drawing of a structure with columns, a dome, and a finial, drawn in black or gray lines and much smaller in scale compared to the statue. The composition is centered on a light cream or off-white background, with ample blank space surrounding the subjects.
title: Carved Wood Figure - "Flying Mercury"
